nodes.label: Spatial Inductive Bias
nodes.desc: Assumption that nearby pixels have higher spatial correlation than distant pixels.

nodes.label: Weight Sharing (Tied Weights)
nodes.desc: Reusing identical kernel weights across spatial positions to achieve translational equivariance.

nodes.label: Local Receptive Field
nodes.desc: Spatial region in the input tensor that influences a specific feature map activation.

nodes.label: Translational Equivariance
nodes.desc: f(g(x)) = g(f(x)): Shifting an object in the input shifts its representation correspondingly.

nodes.label: Vanishing Gradient Problem
nodes.desc: Exponential decay of backpropagated gradients in deep multi-layered architectures.

nodes.label: Tabular Inductive Mismatch
nodes.desc: Disadvantage of Conv1D on arbitrary feature-ordered heterogeneous tabular columns.

nodes.label: 2D Convolutional Layer
nodes.desc: Discretized 2D cross-correlation operator with trainable kernel tensors.

nodes.label: 1D Convolutional Layer
nodes.desc: 1D sliding filter across temporal or sequence-ordered vector dimensions.

nodes.label: Depthwise Separable Conv
nodes.desc: Factorization into depthwise spatial convolution followed by 1x1 pointwise channel projection.

nodes.label: Residual Skip Connection
nodes.desc: Identity shortcut y = F(x) + x allowing pristine gradient backpropagation.

nodes.label: Batch Normalization (BN)
nodes.desc: Stabilizes internal covariate shift by normalizing layer activations across mini-batches.

nodes.label: Max Pooling
nodes.desc: Non-linear downsampling selecting the maximum element in local windows.

nodes.label: Average Pooling
nodes.desc: Spatial aggregation computing local arithmetic mean across receptive windows.

nodes.label: Global Average Pooling (GAP)
nodes.desc: Averages each spatial feature map into a single scalar, drastically eliminating dense parameters.

nodes.label: Dropout Regularization
nodes.desc: Stochastic deactivation of neurons during training to prevent co-adaptation.

nodes.label: Basic Baseline CNN
nodes.desc: Canonical 2-stage Conv2D + MaxPool + Dense baseline network.

nodes.label: LeNet-5 (LeCun 1998)
nodes.desc: Foundational architecture utilizing 5x5 kernels and progressive sub-sampling.

nodes.label: VGG-Style (Simonyan 2014)
nodes.desc: Deep stacked 3x3 convolutions with homogeneous blocks and Batch Normalization.

nodes.label: ResNet-Style (He 2015)
nodes.desc: Deep residual network with identity shortcuts solving degradation across deep layers.

nodes.label: MobileNetV2 (Sandler 2018)
nodes.desc: Lightweight architecture with inverted residuals and linear bottlenecks for edge computing.

nodes.label: Conv1D Tabular Clinical Net
nodes.desc: 1D convolutional network adapted for clinical biomarker risk stratification.

nodes.label: NumPy Pure Scratch CNN
nodes.desc: Explicit forward and backward algorithmic implementation without PyTorch/Autograd.

nodes.label: Categorical Cross-Entropy Loss
nodes.desc: Log-loss quantifying discrepancy between ground-truth and predicted categorical probabilities.

nodes.label: Grad-CAM (Selvaraju 2017)
nodes.desc: Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping highlighting visual decision regions.

nodes.label: 95% Bootstrap Confidence Intervals
nodes.desc: Non-parametric empirical confidence estimation via B=1000 resamples.

nodes.label: Multi-class Confusion Matrix
nodes.desc: Contingency matrix evaluating class-specific true positives, false positives, and errors.

nodes.label: Macro-Averaged F1-Score
nodes.desc: Unweighted mean of class F1 scores, crucial for evaluating imbalanced distributions.
